frase.texto: I encourage you to begin to share with your Episcopal Conferences and Dioceses what you have lived and received, and to continue proclaiming the Gospel with families, drawing on the richness of Amoris laetitia
frase.fuente: Mensaje de conclusión del encuentro sobre Amoris laetitia

fuente.titulo: Pope Leo: 'May families actively participate in life of the Church' - Vatican News

bajada: Mensaje de conclusión del encuentro sobre Amoris laetitia · 2026
caption:
“I encourage you to begin to share with your Episcopal Conferences and Dioceses what you have lived and received, and to continue proclaiming the Gospel with families, drawing on the richness of Amoris laetitia”

— Pope Leo XIV, Mensaje de conclusión del encuentro sobre Amoris laetitia (2026)

Via Vatican News, 14 October 2026
